programme.title: Football - Spanish league: Rayo Vallecano - Celta 31.10.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League: Fenerbahce - Liverpool
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet.

programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Anderlecht - Salzburg
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year.

programme.title: Blue, an ocean of solutions
programme.desc: Explorer Maud Fontenoy goes to Australia, a continent-country that has always known how to live with the sea. She sets off to discover the Great Barrier Reef. Throughout her explorations, Maud Fontenoy shares her knowledge of the ocean and the infinite resources it has to offer, in order to reconnect the vital links that unite humans to the kingdom of the seas. In the ocean there are a multitude of solutions essential to our future: oxygen, water, food, tomorrow's first aid kit, climate regulation, and even energy.

programme.title: Extreme passions
programme.desc: We follow extreme runners along the ridges of Moorea. From physical preparation to the final race, we experience their training and the vibrations of the race to take on this extreme challenge. The Xterra race in Polynesia is distinguished by its demanding course and breathtaking landscapes. Among the notable athletes, Cédric Wane, a local champion, embodies the spirit of trail running in Polynesia. The Xterra in Polynesia is a real challenge for him. It is an experience that links sporting competition and human adventure.

programme.title: Let Me Run
programme.desc: Portrait of four sportswomen and activists, whose journeys are intertwined with the great history of female emancipation through sport. Thus, we discover the stories of Hiyori Kon, Japanese sumotori defying traditions, Khadija Sambe, Senegalese surfer in a country without female surfers, Ernestine Shepherd, 86-year-old American bodybuilder and finally Laurence Fischer, former karate world champion and activist for women victims of violence.

programme.title: Blue, an ocean of solutions
programme.desc: My name is Maud Fontenoy. I have spent more time in my life on the oceans than on land. The ocean has always fascinated me: its vibrant breath, its sudden groans, its mysterious horizon, its sometimes dark, indecipherable sky. I resisted its rapid gusts like animals, the cold, the fatigue and the salt that burns your eyes. The sea is in my head, in my heart. I just have to close my eyes to hear its rumblings. She taught me humility and perseverance. Today I put this obstinacy at the service of its preservation. We all need the Big Blue for our survival, it is the keystone of the machinery that allows life on Earth. It's time to get to know the Ocean better.

programme.title: Extreme passions
programme.desc: Paragliding in Polynesia attracts enthusiasts from all over the world thanks to its spectacular landscapes and ideal weather conditions. Pierre Florentin, a pioneer in Polynesia, founded the “Vol Libre Polynésien” and the “Airevasion” club. Direction Tahiti where Pierre and his students fly above the lagoon to the neighboring islands, making the Polynesian islands an incomparable place of experience where the earth meets the sky.

programme.title: Blue, an ocean of solutions
programme.desc: In the heart of the Pacific Islands, in the islands of Fiji and Tonga, Maud Fontenoy sets out to discover the inhabitants who have forged a deep bond with the ocean. The study of bull sharks, the protection of manta rays or the fascinating analysis of the songs of humpback whales reveal the incredible richness of this marine biodiversity. Through these unique moments of sharing, Maud highlights the crucial importance of the ocean for residents. But today, faced with climate change, she understands the challenges they face and the importance of combining ancestral traditions and environmental issues.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: Village Of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their father's death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: As a scholar and his lover are torn apart forever by his uncle and his friend, and drive the girl to commit suicide. The girl returns as ghost and seek revenge.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng flees to San Francisco after he is framed for drug possession. He assists Philip Kwok's notorious White Dragons in a vicious gang war, only to then be betrayed.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Alex is happily married to a gynecologist, Tung for five years. When Alex is fatally wounded in an accident, he feels obliged to tell Tung about his affair with Blackie.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: As the roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collected proofs of corruption from the officials, they demanded to become the governor of the country.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: The Sung Dynasty army's Chief Instructor is on a danger-fraught pilgrimage to the Tung Yueh Temple.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Shaw Bros and TVB stars unite for Wang Feng's ensemble epic. Trouble is brewing when a gangster plans to change the Gossip Street residents' favourite hangout into a gambling den.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: An award-winning film in 1978. Liu Yu-Te escapes to Shaolin Temple, mastered the skill of 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers. Succeeded his revenge and introduced the 36th Chamber.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua as a swordswoman out to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the sharpest blade in the world.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Inspired by the relationship between Stanly Ho and his fourth wife, Angela, it's a romantic comedy about a billonaire who falls in love with a feisty casino dealer.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a story that takes place when Yeong-ho, who is good for being alone, and Hyeon-jin, a competent publisher who is not okay to be alone, make a book about single life.

programme.title: Drive (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Yoo-Na is a popular YouTuber with over 700,000 subscribers. She enjoys her life, but, one night, she is kidnapped by an unidentified person. The kidnapper orders her to earn 650 million won through a one hour broadcast.

programme.title: The Childe (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Desperate to get funds for his mother's surgery, an amateur boxer travels from the Philippines to Korea in hopes of tracking down his father. However, in the process, he gets involved with some bad guys.

programme.title: Cobweb
programme.desc: Director Kim has completed filming Cobweb, but he decided to re-shoot the ending. With chaos and people don't understand the new ending, will Kim be able to complete his masterpiece?

programme.title: Office
programme.desc: The investigation following a sales manager brutally killing his entire family leads to a track of mystery and tragedy in an overwhelmed work team at Seoul.

programme.title: I, The Executioner
programme.desc: Rookie detective Park Sun Woo and Seo Do-Cheol, a veteran of the Violent Crimes Investigation Division team, chase after a serial killer who shakes up their world.

programme.title: Exhuma
programme.desc: The process of excavating an ominous grave unleashes long hidden secrets and dreadful consequences buried underneath.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment
programme.desc: Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to nab Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.

programme.title: Veteran
programme.desc: A honest cop seeks justice for a common man against all odds. A rich boy seeks revenge on the cop.

programme.title: Office
programme.desc: The investigation following a sales manager brutally killing his entire family leads to a track of mystery and tragedy in an overwhelmed work team at Seoul.

programme.title: Single In Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Eun Hee returns to her old high school as vice principal. When strange sounds and a ghostly figure appear in a closed washroom, she realizes the mystery is connected to her past and her return to the school.

programme.title: Decibel (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: A former navy commander receives a threatening call who claims to blow up a stadium with a sound-responsive bomb. He must face the secret he left buried in the deep sea to track this terrorist down.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five follows five strangers whose lives change dramatically after each receives an organ transplant from the same donor. Soon, they discover that the transplants have granted them extraordinary powers ranging from enhanced strength to unique supernatural abilities. While struggling to understand their new identities, the group becomes the target of a powerful and ambitious individual who seeks to obtain their abilities at any cost. Forced to work together despite their differences, the unlikely heroes embark on a thrilling adventure filled with action, humor, and teamwork as they fight to protect themselves and those around them.

programme.title: Hello Ghost
programme.desc: A man's failed suicide attempt enables him to see ghosts, who later keep following him everywhere. It is now up to him to fulfill their wishes to make them go away.

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: During the extradition to Korea, a group of dangerous criminals united to stage an escape from the floating prison.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: People reminiscing about their first love stories as they listen to love stories on the radio. During a live broadcast, a radio DJ receives a letter that shares stories from a fishing village 23 years ago.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: A man who became a suspect in a closed-door murder seeks help from an attorney to prove him innocent. As they begin to piece the puzzle together, the truth slowly reverses.

programme.title: Where Would You Like To Go?
programme.desc: A school teacher Do-kyeong (Jun Seok-ho) dies as he fails to save his student Ji-yong from drowning. After the two pass away, Do-kyeong's wife Myeong-ji (Park Ha-sun) and Ji-yong's sister Ji-eun are left alone in the world, having to cope with the loss of their loved ones. Myeong-ji travels to Warsaw, Poland, to stay distanced from her harsh reality and meets an old friend to whom she hides her husband's death as if she is trying to reject the tragedy. While she is unable to let him go, Ji-eun is hospitalized as her health condi- tion worsens. Lacking any enthusiasm for life, Ji-eun also struggles to recover. On the day of the Warsaw Uprising, where people commemorate the death of victims of their dark history, Myeong-ji returns to her home in Korea, where a letter from Ji-eun is awaiting.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Follows a single father who has to keep his daughter a secret from his first love from high school, who he meets again by chance, but who he discovers has no interest in dating anyone with children.

programme.title: The Boys
programme.desc: A story about an investigating team leader, Hwang Joon-cheol, in charge of investigating boys who are suspected of robbery at the local town's supermarket, 'Woori Super'.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: Genius Mathematician defected from the North tried to hide his past eventually started teaching a student who gave up on Maths the right way to find the answer.

programme.title: Rebound
programme.desc: A rookie basketball coach lead 6 'no-body' players for straight matches in 8 days and turn the impossible possible.

programme.title: Love 911
programme.desc: When a doctor gets sued for misdiagnosing a patient, she reaches out to a dedicated firefighter to be a character witness for her. An unlikely romance sparks between the two of them.

programme.title: Najlepsi bramkarze Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych bramkarzy lat 90., którzy zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy Olivera Kahna, Gabora Kiraly'a, Jensa Lehmanna czy Dirka Heynena.

programme.title: Najlepsi pomocnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Thomas Haessler, Christian Ziege, Mehmet Scholl, Stefan Effenberg, Andreas Moller... w latach 90. po boiskach niemieckiej Bundesligi biegało wielu świetnych pomocników. Piłkarze grający na tej pozycji walnie przyczynili się do sukcesów reprezentacji Niemiec w ostatniej dekadzie XX wieku.

programme.title: Bundesliga Clubs

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.

programme.title: Formuła 1: Grand Prix Meksyku

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Udinese Calcio - AS Roma
programme.desc: Udinese w poprzedniej kolejce ponownie nie zdołało odnieść zwycięstwa, remisując bezbramkowo z Parmą. Było to już jego siódme ligowe spotkanie z rzędu bez wygranej. Domowe starcie z AS Romą zapowiada się więc dla gospodarzy jako bardzo duże wyzwanie, zwłaszcza że ekipa z Rzymu do tej pory nie przegrała i przed 10. serią spotkań zajmuje trzecie miejsce w tabeli. Goście w ostatniej kolejce pokonali Cagliari 4:2.

programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Bayer 04 Leverkusen - VfB Stuttgart
programme.desc: Stuttgart jest cieniem drużyny, która ukończyła poprzedni sezon Bundesligi na czwartym miejscu w tabeli. Die Roten balansują tuż nad strefą spadkową, mając na koncie aż pięć porażek w siedmiu kolejkach. Biorąc pod uwagę okoliczności, ich zwycięstwo nad Bayerem Leverkusen wydaje się mało prawdopodobnym scenariuszem.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: SS Lazio - Cagliari Calcio
programme.desc: Trwa piękny sen Lazio. W dziewięciu dotychczasowych kolejkach Serie A Orły odniosły osiem zwycięstw i zanotowały jeden remis. Równie imponującym bilansem może poszczycić się tylko liderujący w tabeli Inter Mediolan. Rzymianie spróbują dotrzymać kroku urzędującemu mistrzowi Włoch w spotkaniu z Cagliari.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Milan - Inter Mediolan
programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.desc: Nicola Zalewski cieszy się umiarkowanym zaufaniem Maurizio Sarriego. Jednakże, gdy już dostaje od trenera szansę, z reguły nie zawodzi. Przekonamy się, czy pomoże Atalancie zdobyć punkty w starciu z Parmą.

programme.desc: Obie ekipy mierzyły się kilka dni wcześniej w ramach Pucharu Niemiec. Wówczas 1. FC Köln zaprezentowało się zdecydowanie lepiej i wygrało aż 5:0. Union Berlin z pewnością będzie chciał zrewanżować się przed własną publicznością. W lidze gospodarze, po bardzo słabym początku sezonu, zaczęli punktować. Wygrali jeden mecz i dwukrotnie zremisowali. Z kolei goście niedawno ulegli Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 0:1, a w poprzedniej kolejce bezbramkowo zremisowali z FC Schalke 04.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Potrójna korona Bayernu Monachium
programme.desc: Twórcy dokumentu przypominają historyczny sezon Bayernu Monachium, w którym bawarski zespół wygrał Bundesligę, Puchar Niemiec oraz prestiżową Ligę Mistrzów.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: SL Benfica - FC Alverca
programme.desc: Po dziewięciu kolejkach Benfica traci już pięć oczek do liderującego w tabeli Porto. Orły nie mogą sobie zatem pozwolić na wpadkę w konfrontacji z Alvercą. W poprzedniej kampanii dwukrotnie ograły tego rywala 2:1.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Lille OSC - RC Lens
programme.desc: Lens znajduje się na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu w Ligue1. Przedłużenie dobrej passy nie będzie jednak dla wicemistrzów Francji łatwym zadaniem. W 9. kolejce podopieczni Dino Toppmöllera mierzą się bowiem z Lille, z którym poprzednim razem przegrali wysoko 0:3.

programme.desc: Starcie wielkich firm, które obecny sezon zaczęły zdecydowanie poniżej oczekiwań. Przetrzebiona kontuzjami Stara Dama spróbuje pokonać notującego kolejne wpadki wicemistrza. Szczególnie bolesna była przegrana Błękitnych z zajmującą ostatnie miejsce w tabeli Venezią.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: FC Porto - GD Estoril Praia
programme.desc: FC Porto, mimo słabych wyników w europejskich pucharach, imponuje formą w krajowej lidze, gdzie ma na koncie komplet dziewięciu zwycięstw. Ostatnio Smoki pokonały na wyjeździe Gil Vicente 1:0, a w najbliższym spotkaniu zmierzą się u siebie z ostatnim w tabeli GD Estoril Praia.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Olympique Marsylia - Toulouse FC
programme.desc: Gospodarze mogą pochwalić się serią trzech zwycięstw. W poprzedniej kolejce, po emocjonującym spotkaniu, pokonali Le Havre 4:3. Teraz Olympique Marsylia zmierzy się u siebie z Toulouse FC. Goście mają za sobą bezbramkowy remis z ESTAC Troyes.

programme.desc: W tym programie zobaczymy bramki, które padły zaraz po pierwszym gwizdku sędziego. Okazuje się, że w historii Bundesligi gole strzelone w pierwszych sekundach spotkań wcale nie należały do rzadkości. Niektóre z nich naprawdę warto zobaczyć.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: US Lecce - Genoa CFC
programme.desc: Ostatnie zwycięstwa nad Juventusem i Venezią pozwoliły Genui oddalić się od strefy spadkowej na dystans pięciu punktów. W meczu z Lecce Gryfy postarają się wykonać kolejny krok w kierunku utrzymanie w elicie.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Eintracht Frankfurt - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Zarówno Eintracht Frankfurt, jak i Hamburger SV zanotowały w poprzedniej kolejce porażki. Eintracht uległ 0:1 Borussii Dortmund, natomiast HSV musiał uznać wyższość Paderborn (0:1). Obie ekipy z pewnością postarają się wrócić na zwycięską ścieżkę, co zapowiada wyrównane starcie.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Strasbourg - AJ Auxerre
programme.desc: Strasbourg jest największym rozczarowaniem tej części sezonu. W lidze zdołał wygrać zaledwie 2 spotkania i znajduje się w strefie spadkowej. Dodatkowo na zwycięstwo czeka od 6 września. Przełamać się i tym samym opuścić ostatnie lokaty spróbuje starciem z Auxerre. Zadanie to będzie jednak bardzo trudne. Po fatalnym starcie podopieczni Willa Stilla obudzili się i w ciągu 5 kolejek zdobyli 10 punktów, tym samym zbliżając się do środka stawki.

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.

Kolejne potknięcie nie tylko po raz kolejny oddali go od mistrzostwa, ale także może zrzucić go z ligowego podium. Uniknąć tego spróbuje w rywalizacji z walczącą o utrzymanie Casa Pią.

programme.desc: Nie tak fani Troyes wyobrażali sobie powrót do Ligue 1. Po ośmiu kolejkach ich ulubieńcy znajdują się na przedostatnim miejscu w tabeli z zaledwie jednym zwycięstwem na koncie. Wydostać się ze strefy spadkowej mogą już w tej kolejce. Zmierzą się z Le Mans FC, które zajmuje ostatnią bezpieczną lokatę.

programme.desc: Bologna Łukasza Skorupskiego w poprzedniej kolejce niespodziewanie pokonała AC Milan 4:2. Zwycięstwo z zespołem z Mediolanu pozwoliło jej na wskoczenie na 11. miejsce i tym samym znaczące oddalenie się od strefy spadkowej. Teraz jej celem jest przybliżenie się do lokat pozwalających na grę w europejskich pucharach. A dobrą okazję do tego będzie miała już w tej kolejce. Zmierzy się z Monzą, która od początku rozgrywek rozczarowuje. Wygrała zaledwie 2 spotkania i cały czas krąży nad ostatnimi pozycjami w lidze.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league: Cleveland - Oklahoma City
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Football - English league: Newcastle - Everton
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Football - Italian league: Sassuolo - Fiorentina
programme.desc: Serie A is a professional football competition that consists of 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Racing - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - Mozart Bet Superliga: Macva - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and operates according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white team is more successful.

programme.title: Football - Champions League: Galatasaray - Stuttgart
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Cup: Buducnost Krušik - Partizan
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competitions with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Celtic - Besiktas
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and it was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Olympiacos - Red Star
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.desc: Brasileirao Seria A is the first Brazilian league founded in 1959. Due to geographical reasons, the history of the single league in Brazil is relatively short. programme.title: Football - French League: Toulouse - Strasbourg
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the title of French champion. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game.

programme.title: Football - English league: Everton - Coventry
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League: Boca Juniors - River Plate
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league was Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is followed closely by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors.

The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year.

programme.title: Football - English league: Everton - Coventry
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Football - English league
programme.desc: The Premier League is the highest professional football league in England. It is a competition of 20 clubs from the island. The season lasts from August to May, in which each team plays 38 matches. Under this name, the competition has been held since 1992, when it was formed by clubs that withdrew from the First Division of the Football League, the highest league in England from 1888 until then. It became the most watched sports league!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Sevilla - Alaves
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - Italian league
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship.

programme.title: Football - Italian league: Venezia - Udinese
programme.desc: Serie A is a professional football competition that consists of 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches.

programme.title: Football - Germany 2nd league: E. Braunschweig - Cottbus
programme.desc: The 2. Bundesliga is regarded as one of the most popular non-top flight football competitions in its own country. The average number of spectators at those matches exceeds some of the first leagues of other football countries, while it is the leader among other leagues. It is right up there with the English Championship in viewership. The concept and format of the league changed over the years, as did the turbulent history of that country. The league became fully professional in the 1970s and was divided into several regions. The current form with a unique second division dates back to 1992.

programme.title: Football - German league: HSV - B. Monchengladbach
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it.
